description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Viewdeletemodule' that extends 'SugarView'. It is responsible for handling the display logic when a module is deleted within the SuiteCRM framework. The class includes methods for generating the module title parameters and rendering a confirmation message via AJAX when a module is deleted.

classes.name: Viewdeletemodule
classes.description: A view class responsible for displaying deletion confirmation in the module builder interface within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates parameters for the module title, including the module name and title obtained from ModuleBuilderController.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Creates an AjaxCompose object, adds a section indicating the module was deleted, and outputs the corresponding JavaScript.
